# Operator operator -

#### operator -(Direction3D)

Negates a direction.

##### Declaration

```
public static Direction3D operator -(Direction3D inDirection)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  Direction3D |  inDirection |  Direction to negate.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- |
